demoSaas.pageSubtitle: A production-ready template for B2B SaaS with enterprise auth, billing, multi-tenancy, webhooks, audit logs, feature flags, and observability built in from day one.

overview.title: Reference architecture
overview.subtitle: Decoupled services, per-tenant data isolation, and end-to-end observability.

highlights.title: Design decisions
items: Per-tenant isolation via Postgres row-level security
Signed JWT sessions with rotating JWKS keys
Webhook queue with exponential retries and a dead letter queue
OpenTelemetry data shipped to a central collector
Feature flags evaluated at the edge for minimal latency
